source_register.title: PayShap Request FAQs
supports: A ShapID is usually the primary cellphone number registered with Nedbank.
A number already registered as a default ShapID at another bank must be deregistered there before becoming the Nedbank default; a bank-qualified form can be used.
Nedbank says an old ShapID that no longer matches the customer's primary cellphone number is automatically deleted at end of business day after a number change.
Nedbank describes checking that the cellphone number linked to its account is owned by the same person.
does_not_support: A universal PayShap alias deletion SLA across participants.
A telecom subscriber record alone as bank-account ownership proof.

source_register.title: PayShap product and FAQ page
supports: Standard Bank describes bank-qualified ShapIDs and one primary ShapID among aliases at multiple banks.
The provider documents editing and deleting ShapIDs.
The payment flow displays the recipient name and ShapID/legal name for payer confirmation.
does_not_support: A common cross-bank alias state machine or global directory SLA.
A universal cooling-off rule for phone-number reassignment.

source_register.title: Final Numbering Plan Fourth Amendment Regulations announcement
supports: ICASA says the Fourth Amendment standardises churn, deactivation and recycling of inactive mobile numbers.
The announcement says subscribers are to have a reasonable opportunity to retain numbers before deactivation.
The announcement describes a six-month transition from Gazette publication for licensee implementation.
does_not_support: The exact implementation date from the news page alone.
A specific operator's current recycling or quarantine interval.
A PayShap bank alias deregistration deadline.

source_register.title: Draft Numbering Plan Fifth Amendment Regulations 2026 announcement
supports: The draft proposes mobile subscriber registration and biometric verification on assignment/activation/reactivation and SIM-swap requests.
ICASA says the draft was published for public comment with 30 days for submissions.
does_not_support: A final binding biometric rule as of 4 November 2026.
Proof that any particular operator has implemented the draft proposals.

source_register.title: Numbering Plan and ownership overview
supports: ICASA allocates national numbering resources to licensed operators, who assign numbers to subscribers.
does_not_support: A permanent identity relationship between a mobile number and one subscriber.
Bank-account ownership or ShapID registration status.
